sloka: इत्युक्त्वा सहसोत्पत्य प्लुप्लुवे तस्य चोपरि ।आकृष्य मुकुटं चित्रं पातयामास तद्भुवि ।। ६-४०-११।।
transliteration: ityuktvā sahasotpatya plupluve tasya copari ।ākṛṣya mukuṭaṁ citraṁ pātayāmāsa tadbhuvi ।। 6-40-11।।

translations.english: Having spoken thus, Sugriva got up speedily and flew to the top of the tower (here Ravana was located) held the diadem and pushed it on the ground.
